audit_items.proof_trace: The property holds. bcrypt.compare enforces timing safety through the Blowfish key schedule, which executes a fixed 2^10 iterations unconditionally regardless of input byte values — this is the dominant, practically observable operation. The final hash comparison (60 chars) is either already constant-time in bcryptjs 3.0.3 or, if not, is information-theoretically safe: an attacker without access to the stored client_secret_hash cannot leverage byte-by-byte timing differences in the comparison, and any variance is buried in HTTP jitter. Only one caller exists (token/route.ts:61) with no bypass path.
